summary: First-party speech-analysis Generator that delegates ASR execution to a narrow Host tool and returns a typed transcript Document.
context_hints: Keep provider credentials, local paths, Local API URLs, and runtime model spellings in the Host; plugin code calls context.hostTools.speechTranscribe
Generator state stores only a canonical model Card id; language is an Action parameter frozen into the ActionRun fingerprint
Never synthesize word timings: media.transcript@1 must pass AsrTimedTranscriptSchema with real non-zero ranges
The exported plugin is an inert PluginModule; stdio starts only when dist/stdio.mjs is executed directly

subdirectories.src: Transport-neutral PluginModule plus direct-execution stdio compatibility entrypoint.
subdirectories.contract-tests: Declarative activation fixture for a completed typed transcript.
subdirectories.dist: Generated standalone compatibility artifact; never hand-edit.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned clash.asr package, Generator, Action, and speech.transcribe Host-tool declarations.
key_files.generators/speech-analysis.json: Mutable Generator state and exact transcribe input/output contract.
key_files.src/stdio.ts: Inert PluginModule with durable submit/poll mapping; direct execution alone enables stdio.
key_files.contract-tests/transcribe.json: Completed ASR Host-tool and typed Document ABI fixture.
